label: v0.9.5 — FIX: the FA pool no longer vanishes ~30s after loading. loadFa() runs on the 30s refresh and a transient fa-pool failure (.catch(()=>null)) wiped STATE.faPool to [] — the Players tab would populate and then go blank. Now last-good is preserved and only replaced on a successful, non-empty read. The heavy fa-pool + adp-board (~1800 players) are also throttled to a 5-min TTL instead of re-downloading every 30s (the live board/lots still tick every 30s), which removes the main source of those transient failures.
changes_091: Tracker rebuilt as a Nominations audit: per-day X/2 compliance for every owner, click an owner to see exactly which players they nominated and when (replaces the catch-all War Room cards).
Players: the Nominate action is hidden (—) when the auction isn't running — browse-only off-season, on both the FA pool and the ERA table.
Header meta no longer sticks on 'Loading…' on the default FA Auction tab (now set every paint).
Bid-history fetch limit 200 → 500 so the audit trail is more complete.
description: The hub now mirrors the mobile app: two top tabs (FA Auction · Expired Rookie), each broken into five sub-sections — Summary, Players, Lots, History, Tracker — instead of six flat tabs and one long FA scroll. A pill strip switches sub-sections and the body re-renders into a single container. Lots and History are split per auction (a player in the ERA-eligible pool → ERA, else FA). Summary leads with headline KPIs; the old Nominations tab folds into Lots (Open/Completed/All chips) and War Room into Tracker. Team Budgets columns are relabeled from the confusing 'Max Bid @27%/@35%' to 'Max Bid → 27-man / → 35-man' — 27 and 35 are roster sizes (§B1), not percentages; the value is the most you can spend on one player and still afford a legal roster filled to that size.

changes.summary: FA pool populate-then-vanish fix. The 30s auto-refresh re-ran loadFa(); any failed/ok:false/empty fa-pool response reset STATE.faPool to [] (same for the ADP map), blanking the Players tab until a later refresh happened to succeed. Failures now preserve the last-good pool; fa-pool + adp-board re-fetch at most every 5 minutes (FA_POOL_TTL_MS) rather than every 30s.

FA pool ADP fix: was ranking by the adp-board's DYNASTY consensus, which buries aging starters (Dak Prescott showed #153, below IDP role players ranked in the 40s via an over-scaled ECR value). Now ranks by REDRAFT value (FantasyCalc + KTC redraft SF) since the auction is for this season — Dak → #30 QB11, Saquon #194→#28, IDP fall below startable offense (#328+). Also: prior-season points are labeled 'pts' (total) when the worker hasn't yet shipped the per-game split, instead of mislabeling the season total as 'PPG'; flips to '<ppg> PPG · <total> pts' once /api/auction/fa-pool's W=ALL change deploys.

FA pool (Available Players): added position chips + NFL-team dropdown + name/ID search (was a deferred item; the ERA tab already had filters). ADP now comes from /api/adp-board — the SAME multi-source consensus (FantasyCalc + KeepTradeCut + DynastyProcess + Sleeper) the Stats workbench uses — shown as overall consensus rank + positional rank, replacing the single-source FantasyCalc overallRank. Prior-season column fixed: it was labeling the full-season TOTAL points as 'PPG'; worker now fetches W=ALL → real games-played → per-game PPG, and the cell shows '<ppg> PPG · <total> pts'.

Restructured into two auction tabs × five sub-sections (Summary/Players/Lots/History/Tracker), mirroring the mobile app — replaces six flat tabs and the long FA scroll. Lots + History split per auction; Nominations→Lots, War Room→Tracker. Summary KPI strip added. Team Budgets columns relabeled to roster targets (27-man / 35-man) since 27/35 are §B1 roster sizes, not percentages.

FA Auction Pool tab activated (live lots + team budgets @27/@35 + roster needs + available pool from /acquisition-hub/free-agent-auction/live). ERA + FA tabs now honor the commish ERA/FAA switches via era_enabled/faa_enabled on /api/auction/lots — read-only 'not running' banner when off, live board when on, refreshed on the 30s cadence. Mirrors the mobile redesign so one set of switches controls both surfaces.

ERA-Eligible table redesign: dropped Age/Prior Owner/Rookie Slot/Rookie Salary columns; added 2023/2024/2025 PPG + 3-2-1 weighted avg; added live High Bid / High Bidder / Bids columns (LEFT JOIN ups_auction_lots). Fixed Origin classification — was returning Other for backfilled players; now resolves Rookie Draft / FA Auction / WW / MYM-Rookie via draftResults + transactions probe.

ERA nomination cadence switched from rolling 12h cooldown to ANCHORED 12h windows (6 AM / 6 PM ET). Opens Sat 6 PM ET, closes end of Tue 6 AM–6 PM ET window. Banner + per-franchise card show current window label + used_in_window.
